grep.love

Make a pattern better.

Edit a file in patterns/, add matching and nonmatching examples to tests/cases.json, and open a pull request.

Use POSIX extended regex compatible with LC_ALL=C grep -E. One expression per line, without blank lines or comments.

Add new endpoints and their limitations to catalog.json, then run:

python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
python3 scripts/build.py

See CONTRIBUTING.md in the source repository for the full guide.
